blocks.title: Every restyled app.
blocks.lead: Each app below: what changed from the LineageOS original and what the N9 look brings to it. Every stock option stays.

paragraphs: Etesian ROM builds come with the Meeye icon pack by YeyeBBC preinstalled, unmodified and signed by its author, and set as the launcher’s default icon pack; Settings → Appearance credits it with a link to their work. It is not made by the project. Its icons are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (the release’s own LICENSE file says CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). A switch adds N9-style lighting to the icons.

items.title: Phone
items.text: The dialer and call screens, with the N9 dial pad.

items.title: Contacts
items.text: Squircle photos, one list with N9 fast scroll, every way to reach someone on their card, and the N9 menu.

items.title: Mail
items.text: Thunderbird for Android, rebranded and restyled. Included when the build has its prebuilt APK.

items.title: Camera
items.text: Aperture.

items.title: Browser
items.text: Jelly, with an address bar that stays put while you scroll.

items.title: Files
items.text: DocumentsUI, restyled; it opens on Documents.

items.title: Calculator, FM Radio, Recorder, AudioFX
items.text: Restyled to match.

items.title: Keyboard
items.text: The N9 keyboard look on LatinIME, with the clipboard and autofill chips kept clear of the N9 strip. Key click in and out.

items.title: Settings
items.text: Every stock option in N9 lists, and pull down to search. N9 selection sheets.

items.title: Glance
items.text: Search everything, and the news. Built into the ROM; also released as a standalone app.

home.title: System apps that look and feel native.
home.lead: Every default LineageOS app is adapted to the same design language, pairing color-accented headers and bottom toolbars with N9-style switches, squircle-half buttons, fast scrolling, and airy typography—without losing a single stock option.

items.title: Contacts

items.title: Messaging
items.text: Conversations in N9 bubbles, sides as on the N9.

items.title: Mail
items.text: Thunderbird for Android, restyled, when the build includes it.

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Etar, restyled; today’s entries also appear in Events.

items.title: Music
items.text: Twelve, restyled, with generated covers. A Belle music widget is on the Widgets view.

items.title: Gallery
items.text: Glimpse: photos edge to edge, sharing from the toolbar.
